# Release checklist

Generated from `tests/acceptance/cells.json` by `tools/acceptance_manifest.py`. Do not hand-edit the generated span; regenerate it and commit the result. `--check` regenerates and diffs, failing `acceptance-enumeration` when this file has drifted from the enumeration.

Run the acceptance target before tagging a release:

    tests/acceptance/run.py --all --allow-skip <cell> ...

Every 77 (skip) must be named on that command line, or the run does not count as a release gate (docs/design-0.3.1-test-ladder.md §2).

## Speed against the last release

The served cells' floors are a report; the speed gate is a same-window A/B (DESIGN.md §5). For each service on its card, with the units' flags:

    tests/acceptance/ab.py <agent|coder|flashnext> --old <last release's arcint> --new <candidate's arcint> --gguf <model> --device GPU.N --assets <dir> [--rounds 2] [--out DIR]

- [ ] agent: exit 0 (candidate not slower than the last release beyond the old arm's spread, at least 0.5 %; its own spread at most 0.5 % above the old's; answers right)
- [ ] coder: exit 0
- [ ] flashnext: exit 0
